'''''Carex demissa'''''<!-- common yellow sedge and green-yellow sedge seem to apply to ''Carex viridula'' --> is a species of sedge (genus ''[[Carex]]'') native to Iceland, [[Macaronesia]], all of Europe, and western Asia, extending to the Himalayas and possibly Greenland.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pan-arctic flora: Home|url=http://panarcticflora.org/results?biogeographic=&bioclimatic=&region=&name=Carex+demissa#paf-3309023|access-date=2021-06-19|website=panarcticflora.org}}</ref> It has been introduced to eastern Canada, New Jersey, and Tasmania.<ref name="299420-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:299420-1 |title=''Carex demissa'' Hornem. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=28 February 2025}}</ref> It is a member of the ''[[Carex flava]]'' [[species complex]].<ref name="1_of_1120_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=Cut from the same cloth: The convergent evolution of dwarf morphotypes of the ''Carex flava'' group (Cyperaceae) in Circum-Mediterranean mountains |year=2017 |last1=Jiménez-Mejías |first1=Pedro |last2=Benítez-Benítez |first2=Carmen |last3=Fernández-Mazuecos |first3=Mario |last4=Martín-Bravo |first4=Santiago |journal=PLOS ONE |volume=12 |issue=12 |article-number=e0189769 |doi=10.1371/journal.pone.0189769 |pmid=29281689 |pmc=5744957 |bibcode=2017PLoSO..1289769J |doi-access=free }}</ref>

==Subspecies==
The following subspecies are currently accepted:<ref name="299420-1" />
*''Carex demissa'' subsp. ''cedercreutzii'' <small>(Fagerstr.) Jac.Koopman</small> – [[Azores]]
*''Carex demissa'' subsp. ''demissa'' – Europe, Madeira, Canary Islands, the Caucasus, Iran, Afghanistan, and the western Himalayas
